| Concept | Type | Description |

| [Use-case solution evaluation](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Answers "does the envisioned solution fit the need and what the plant has, or does it quietly require more capability than anyone named?". Ranks the use case against a library of known configurations, rates its complexity, finds the IT/OT focus areas it depends on, compares the required level with the plant's as-is level with evidence, and sequences any gap. Ends in a score and one of four verdicts: ready to build, raise a named capability first, over-engineered, or escalate as a platform investment. Use once a use case is scoped and before its business case, when a solution looks more complex than the need, or when a target is set "as high as possible". Also profiles the as-is maturity of one machine, system or application. Not for costing (bc-build) or defining the use case (funnel-use-case). |
